description: Select a component in the AudioEye inspector panel on the last scanned page: scrolls its `instance` (0-based, default 0) into view, outlines it on the page, highlights it in Chrome DevTools and opens the panel on that component. Use it to show the user "that button" without them touching the panel. Requires a scan with the inspector mounted; `componentKey` comes from `componentClusters` in the latest saved scan JSON.

componentKey.description: `componentKey` of a component from the latest saved scan JSON.

name: audioeye_inspect
title: Inspect a scanned component
